Upcoming Payment Milestone – Pre-Intimation
PAYMENT NOTIFICATION PRE-INTIMATION
UPCOMING PAYMENT Upcoming Payment Milestone – Pre-Intimation Dear {!Contact.Name},
This is a pre-intimation regarding your upcoming payment milestone/tranche under your booking. The payment milestone is scheduled for {!Milestone_Date}, which is more than 15 days from today. PAYMENT DETAILS
Project {!Project.Name} Unit {!Unit.Name} Milestone / Tranche {!Milestone_Name} Due Date {!Milestone_Date} Amount Due {!Amount_Due}
IMPORTANT We request you to kindly take note of the upcoming due date and make the required payment on or before the scheduled date to ensure a smooth payment process.
A formal payment reminder will be shared closer to the due date, if applicable.
For any clarification or assistance, please contact our Customer Service team.
Regards, Customer Service Team {!Company__c.Name}
